extension.summary: Shared code, artwork and window for the Vintage Radar screensaver and app
extension.description: The aircraft model and feed, the phosphor radar scope, its text renderer and window, and the shared font atlases and radar artwork used by both Vintage Radar front-ends. Installed automatically with Vintage Radar or the Vintage Radar screensaver. Aircraft data comes from the volunteer-run adsb.lol and OpenSky Network APIs and is used as-is; the typeface is Doto (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
extension.disclaimer: Aircraft data is not for navigation or flight safety. The typeface is Doto under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; its licence text is included with the font atlases.
